detailed_description: Calendar Availability Finder compares each participant's busy blocks against shared work hours and a minimum meeting length, then merges every overlap to surface the open slots that work for the whole group. Rename the sample participants, add or remove people, and drag busy times for each one until the picture matches reality. The minimum meeting length starts at 15 minutes and scales up, so the slot list tightens automatically as you raise it. A visual timeline shows where everyone is free at a glance, and the common slots can be copied as plain text straight into an email or chat thread. Typical uses: finding a standup time for a distributed team, planning a handoff call across time zones, or coordinating a review meeting without a group calendar. The tool runs entirely in the browser and never connects to Google Calendar, Outlook, or any external calendar account — nothing you enter leaves the page.
usage_steps: Set the workday start and end time for the schedule you want to compare.
Choose the minimum meeting duration, using at least 15 minutes.
Rename, add, or remove participants as needed.
Select a participant and add busy start and end times for meetings, interviews, or breaks.
Review the available slots and timeline, then copy the open times if you need to share them.
usage_examples: Find a 30-minute team meeting window after entering everyone's busy blocks.
Compare interview panel availability without connecting private calendars.
Plan office hours around lunch breaks and existing calls.
Copy the remaining free slots into an email or chat thread.

faqs.question: Does it sync with Google Calendar or Outlook?
faqs.answer: No. It is a manual availability calculator. Enter busy times yourself, and the calculation stays in the browser.

faqs.question: Can I add more than the sample participants?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use Add Person to create more participants, then rename them and add their busy slots.

faqs.question: How are overlapping busy times handled?
faqs.answer: Overlapping or adjacent busy blocks are merged before the tool searches for common open time.

faqs.question: What if no slots are found?
faqs.answer: Try widening the work hours, shortening the minimum duration, or removing busy blocks that do not apply.

faqs.question: What should I check before using the Calendar Availability Finder output?
faqs.answer: Review dates, names, totals, and formatting before using the result in a document, schedule, or team handoff.
